reason: My villa lives and dies on the Booking score, and one wrong answer from a robot about check-in or the pool could cost me a 10 and drop me from 9.5 to 9.2. I'm not handing my guests to a new one-person company I've never heard of, even if the money is small.
objection: If the AI tells a guest something wrong or the company disappears mid-season, I'm the one who gets the bad review, not them, and I'm often abroad so I can't fix it fast.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running for a full season at a few other high-end villas nearby with their Booking scores holding or going up, and a named backup person who answers if the founder is unavailable.
